text:
sophie: Alert: big uptick in fnhook validator rejects hitting /generate in us-west starting ~10:07 (roughly 20-40x).
kevin: Ugh. Any error snippets?
sophie: Quick paste from streaming logs:
```
2026-01-18T10:07:11Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error="schema: expected object, got array" sample_id=cd34ef
2026-01-18T10:07:12Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error="toolcall: missing required key 'name'" sample_id=cd34f0
2026-01-18T10:07:13Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error="unexpected top-level array" sample_id=cd34f1
```
maria: Sounds like the agent/model is emitting a top-level list for multi-step prompts. Could be model prompt drift or the adapter's post-processing when coercion is enabled.
kevin: We did push coercion-permissive=true for canary traffic in us-west as part of rollout 0.15 yesterday. If the coercion glue tries to map arrays to toolcall objects, validators will reject.
ops-oncall: Important: are these being attributed as billable fncall traffic? If yes, we need to mute customer billing alarms until we triage.
sophie: Current sample tags: billing=fncall, routing_route=default, fallback_route=routing.degen. So customers are being charged.
maria: Proposed immediate mitigations: a) raise validator sampling to 100% on /generate in us-west for 5m, b) flip coercion-permissive off for canary in that region, c) add a short-lived dashboard panel showing "validator.shape=ARRAY" spikes and top payload samples.
kevin: I can flip sampling and rollback coercion toggle now. deploy-bot, roll back coercion-permissive for canary us-west.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by kevin  job=9881 expected at 10:09 :rocket:
sophie: Also: console currently only shows counts labeled "rejected". We need to surface the shape type (OBJECT/ARRAY) and a clickable example payload for SREs to triage without diving into logs. Small UX change.
maria: Agree. Metric name suggestion: validator.shape_type with labels route, region, validator, and top_examples (linked). Also add a billing_exempt flag for soft-degrades so we can avoid customer alerts while we fix.
kevin: Filing follow-up ENG-18350: dashboard metric + console tooltip + billing flag. Sophie, save 3 representative sample payloads after sampling is up and attach to ticket.
sophie: Will do. Early telemetry after rollback shows rejects trending down (still noisy). Will continue 100% sampling for 10m and post 3 samples. ops-oncall: can you mute billing alerts for the affected route until we confirm?
ops-oncall: muting billing alerts for route=/generate in us-west for 30m (incident mute id: M-4522).
sophie: Thanks. Thread note: thread_ts=1761234600. Will update when sampling window ends. :thumbsup:
